privacy: Files stay on your device. No uploads or remote resources.
formats: Read a self-contained manual, specification, or article.
invalid: This file could not be read as an AsciiDoc document. Check the source in its original editor.
emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose an AsciiDoc document with content.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this document. Close other tabs and try again.
encoding: This document uses an unsupported text encoding. Save a UTF-8 or UTF-16 copy in the original editor.
unsupported: Choose a local .adoc or .asciidoc file. Other file types and documentation projects are not supported.
noContent: This document has no readable content. It may contain only comments, attributes, or unavailable dependencies.
localResources: Some images or styles are unavailable. Files in other folders are not loaded; use a self-contained document with embedded images.
remoteResources: Remote images, styles, and fonts were blocked. The document may look different from the original manual.
safePreview: Scripts and interactive content are disabled. External links open only when you select them.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the document.
projectResources: Includes, custom extensions, diagrams, and project settings are not loaded. Unresolved macros or diagram source may remain as text.
includes: Included files are unavailable. The preview is incomplete; ask the author for a single document with the included content expanded.
parseWarnings: The document contains unresolved references, attributes, or incomplete markup. Some content may be missing or displayed differently.
